meaning: người/agent ↔ CLI: fgos.v1 envelope on every verb, exit-code taxonomy, stdout=data/stderr=diagnostics, machine-readable --help --json verb catalog.
mọi caller ↔ store: single write door, event schema v2, evolution rules, acyclic blocks+parent-child invariant (ADR0012). Multi-process lease still named debt.

orchestrator ↔ worker: dispatch job + verify + proof; fgw/ sandbox; report-not-write fgos-discovered channel (ADR0013). architecture-map maturity was partial; schema allows live|designed|planned only so status is live.
người ↔ hệ (async): ask/answer + awaiting-human; frontier filters waiting work. Version token via work.move SCHEMA_VERSION.
hệ ↔ người (PR): review gate + merge policy + integrated re-verify after merge (STR17). planned — no contract file yet.
agent ↔ agent: routing-handoff contract + trust boundary. designed — full spec, no implementing code gate.
state ↔ reactor: signal pointers, lossy/at-least-once, idempotent consumers (STR8). planned — no contract file yet.
hệ ↔ hub chú ý: attention envelope (gate-opened/question-raised/blocked), versioned. architecture-map maturity was idea; schema has no idea enum so status is planned.
model gateway ↔ provider: executor.v1 runner config {command, args[]} validated at load (RunnerConfigError).
fgos Gateway REST server ↔ web/desktop/API clients: REST /v1 HTTP+JSON; OpenAPI served at /contract.
dispatch ↔ executor adapter: confinement-authority.v1 — prepareConfinementForLaunch door, policy/plan/attestation, fail-closed required.
Workflow step definition ↔ Assignment builder: workflow-step-operation identity, TaskSpec, Skill, Role, dispatch hints.
Assignment repository ↔ Dispatch Control Plane: immutable Assignment request across attempts/recovery; DispatchPlan carried in assignment-run.v2.
